ideas.name: JARVIS personal AI
ideas.description: A personal AI assistant that goes beyond chat. It remembers you, talks by voice, controls your computer, and runs workflows across your devices using both local and cloud AI.
ideas.goal: A personal AI with memory, voice, computer control and cross-device workflows

ideas.name: AI church media platform
ideas.description: Software that helps churches manage their media: sermon recordings, transcripts, searchable archives, event info, auto-made clips, and production workflows.
ideas.goal: App for sermons, events, transcripts, searchable archives and auto clips

ideas.name: Mac Setup Blueprint
ideas.description: A repeatable plan for setting up a Mac the way Seph wants it. Details not written down yet.

ideas.name: Autonomous multi-model workflow
ideas.description: A system where several AIs work together on their own. Muse plans and coordinates, Codex builds and tests, Gemini researches and reviews, and Crosswalk carries messages and keeps records. Runs on existing subscriptions instead of paid APIs.
ideas.goal: Muse orchestrates, Codex builds, Gemini reviews, Crosswalk records, on existing subscriptions

ideas.name: Canvas academic assistant
ideas.description: A tool that connects a student's authorized Canvas coursework to an AI so it can track deadlines, explain assignments, plan study time, and help with exam prep, while respecting privacy and school policies.
ideas.goal: Authorized Canvas coursework connected to an AI for deadlines, scheduling and exam prep
ideas.notes: In discovery: seeking feedback and pilots

ideas.name: ELSEWHERE
ideas.description: A realistic, open-ended life-simulation game. Independent characters, relationships, money, career, health, stress, and memory all change over time, and choices have lasting consequences. Grew out of the Eli Randel story simulation.
ideas.notes: Prototype v0.2 exists (browser, saves, 1,100-turn tests). Not committed to finishing yet.

ideas.name: Selah
ideas.description: A private web app for reading the Bible and staying spiritually accountable. It has a reader with highlights, verse notes, search, and daily reflections, with plans for personal AI memory and Hebrew and Greek study tools.
ideas.notes: Starter prototype exists (reader, highlights, notes, 5 sample verses). Not committed yet.

ideas.name: God on the Move
ideas.description: A long-term spiritual journal that keeps original entries about prayers, revelations, Scripture insights, and meaningful events, and builds a timeline that shows patterns and possible answered prayers over time.
ideas.goal: A long-term spiritual journal and timeline
ideas.notes: Journal instructions and an Oct 3-11 dashboard exist. Not committed yet.

ideas.name: Daily Command Center
ideas.description: A morning briefing that tells Seph what he needs to get done that day and flags important messages and emails.
ideas.goal: Morning Briefing and My Day dashboards

ideas.name: Seahawks Update Center
ideas.description: A Claude Duet artifact that collects Seahawks news through the week (trade updates, injury report, what the media is saying before the game) and ends with a post-game brief covering what happened, media reaction, and some interesting extras.
ideas.notes: Parked as an idea only. Folds in the earlier post-game Duet briefing idea. Part of Claude Duet.
